sentences.en: There was neither saddle nor harness on the horse.
sentences.zh: 这匹马既没有鞍具也没有缰绳。

sentences.en: There was neither a saddle nor a harness on the horse.
sentences.zh: 这匹马既没有鞍具也没有缰绳。

sentences.en: You've got to learn to harness your strength.
sentences.zh: 你必须学会利用你的力量。
